description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application runtime/framework baseline to the latest supported Java modernization target.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested modernization to the latest framework before cloud migration work.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the application from its current Java EE/Java 11 baseline to a latest supported Java modernization baseline compatible with Azure deployment goals.

tasks.description: Modernize application messaging from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus.
tasks.reason: Cloud-native messaging is part of the requested Azure modernization scope.
tasks.requirements: Migrate RabbitMQ-based messaging flows in the wire transfer service to Azure Service Bus with managed identity authentication.

tasks.description: Modernize the data platform from SQL Server connectivity to Azure SQL Database.
tasks.reason: Cloud-native data services are in scope for Azure modernization.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the service database integration from current SQL Server deployment assumptions to Azure SQL Database with managed identity authentication.

tasks.description: Move plaintext/environment-based credential handling to Azure Key Vault.
tasks.reason: Cloud-native secret management is required for secure Azure modernization.
tasks.requirements: Migrate application secrets and sensitive connection data from plain properties/environment configuration to Azure Key Vault with managed identity access.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate dependency CVEs before Azure deployment.
tasks.reason: Security compliance task is mandatory for all modernization plans.
tasks.requirements: Scan all dependencies for CVEs and remediate known vulnerabilities before deployment. If fixes require major upgrades, document risk and compatibility impact.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure as requested.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested deployment to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Containerize as needed and deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps using existing or newly prepared Azure resources.
